title: Fan-in bound under mapping
statement: Let $n,m\in\mathbb{N}$, let $f$ map Boolean circuit trees on $n$ variables to Boolean circuit trees on $n$ variables, and let $cs$ be a finite list of such trees. Suppose every tree $c$ occurring in $cs$ has maximum fan-in at most $m$ after applying $f$. Then the maximum, over the images $f(c)$ for $c$ in the list, of their recursively defined fan-in bounds is at most $m$, where the maximum for an empty list is $0$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ maps Boolean circuit trees on $n$ variables to such trees
$cs$ is a list of Boolean circuit trees on $n$ variables
Every member $c$ of $cs$ satisfies that $f(c)$ has maximum fan-in at most $m$
